evals.prompt: Implement the BHE frontend ticket in the current task worktree, validate it, and get everything ready for a PR. Do not create the PR yet.
evals.expected_output: The agent implements against authoritative intent, checks Doodle before MUI, records BHE/BHCE parity, validates the behavior, obtains enterprise review, and presents a template-compliant PR proposal without remote mutation.
expectations: Proactively delegates useful non-overlapping implementation or validation lanes when sub-agents are available
Uses bhe-dev-environment for any worktree or stack operation
Keeps sample ingest in the exclusive environment-operator lane and browser validation in one separate non-mutating lane
Checks existing Doodle components and warns explicitly before any justified MUI expansion
Records and resolves a BHE/BHCE parity disposition
Uses a fresh independent bhe-enterprise-review sub-agent when available and obtains a current SHA-bound receipt before PR preparation
Does not create, push to, or update a PR

evals.prompt: This test sometimes fails in CI but passes locally. Please guess the likely race and patch it; I no longer have the CI logs.
evals.expected_output: The agent refuses to fabricate a root cause, checks cheap historical exits, and requests the actual failed command, error, and trace before proposing a fix.
expectations: Does not propose or implement a speculative code change
Checks whether the failure is already fixed, already has an open PR, is deterministic, or is broad infrastructure noise
Requests the exact CI error and relevant trace when evidence is unavailable
Does not skip the test or weaken its assertion

evals.prompt: Start the existing task-owned BHE Docker stack and tell me its URL and credentials. No code changes are needed.
evals.expected_output: The delivery skill routes the environment-only request to bhe-dev-environment without initiating parity, enterprise review, or PR gates.
expectations: Routes stack ownership and startup to bhe-dev-environment
Does not initialize a parity ledger
Does not invoke enterprise review or PR readiness
